label: Рост
description: A 10-sentence usage card for рост (growth; height).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Рост' is the masculine noun in the nominative as the subject that worries. 'Цен' is the genitive plural of belonging, and 'нас' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Рост' is the accusative direct object of 'показала'. For inanimate masculine nouns the accusative matches the nominative, and 'быстрый' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Роста' is the genitive form required by 'ждут', the verb of waiting. 'Экономического' is the agreeing masculine genitive adjective.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О росте' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Населения' is the genitive of belonging, the growth of the population.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Росту' is the dative form required by 'способствует', the verb of promoting. 'Растений' is the genitive plural of belonging.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Ростом' is the instrumental form required by 'гордится', here meaning bodily height. 'Высоким' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive of description. 'Роста' is the genitive form in the descriptive phrase of height. 'Небольшого' agrees in the masculine genitive, characterising the boy.

missions.phrase: В этом году мы видим рост продаж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Рост' is the accusative object of 'видим'. 'Продаж' is the genitive plural of belonging, and 'в этом году' gives the time frame.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Роста' is the genitive form required by 'из-за', expressing the cause. 'Спроса' is a second genitive of belonging.

missions.phrase: Девочка измеряет свой рост у стены.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Рост' is the accusative object of 'измеряет', here bodily height. 'Свой' marks it as her own, and 'у стены' is the genitive location.
